name: submit_license_extension
description: submit_license_extension: Submit a provisional or supervised extension request for an expiring provider license. Returns a case_id on success. Rejects the request if the license is not eligible for extension. For provisional extensions, the supervising_physician_npi field is ignored; for supervised extensions, it is required and looked up in the provider directory.

npi.description: The requesting provider's 10-digit NPI number. Example: 1487392045

state_license_number.description: The state license number. Format: STATE-TYPE-NUMBER. Example: MA-RN-004821

extension_type.description: The type of extension: provisional (independent practice, no supervisor) or supervised (practice under a supervising physician)

extension_days.description: Duration of extension in days. Must be exactly 30, 60, or 90.

supervising_physician_npi.description: The supervising physician's 10-digit NPI number — a different provider's NPI from the requesting provider, looked up in the provider directory. Required only when extension_type is supervised. When extension_type is provisional, this field is ignored by the tool and may be omitted, left blank, or set to null.
